description:
Configure JFrog Artifactory to allow Anonymous Read-Only access to public content while protecting secrets. 

Starting state: Global Anonymous Access is disabled. The repository 'example-repo-local' contains two folders: 'public/' and 'secret/'. 

Goal: 
1. Enable Global Anonymous Access in the Security Configuration.
2. Configure a Permission Target (modify existing or create new) so that:
   - Unauthenticated (anonymous) users CAN download artifacts from 'example-repo-local/public/'.
   - Unauthenticated users CANNOT download artifacts from 'example-repo-local/secret/'.
   - Anonymous users must NOT have Deploy/Delete permissions anywhere.

Credentials: admin / password.
